47. Where domestic abuse is alleged in criminal, civil or family cases, special measures will
automatically be available.230 There is more detail of the special measures regime
in chapter 2.
Coercive control

48. Section 76 Serious Crime Act 2015 created an offence of “controlling or coercive behaviour
in intimate or familial relationships”. This offence is constituted by behaviour on the part of
the perpetrator which takes place “repeatedly or continuously” and has a “serious effect” on
the victim.
